propositions: The CLI architecture must consolidate repeated censuses into a single immutable stdlib-only lazy route registry with module:function handler references and deterministic argparse-derived help generation.
Parser definitions must serve as the single authoritative grammar source for both runtime parsing and committed generated syntax documentation, with no separate DSL or docs-only grammars.
Top-level routing and help discovery must complete before RP-04 operation-snapshot composition, config materialization, store mount, and handler resolution.
The capability registry must map to one of four postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) keyed to packaging extras, enforced only after mode/backend selection.
Alias rules (canonical, exact, compatibility, hidden, retired) must permit help reuse and bridge shims without introducing second parsers or plugin frameworks.
Migration strategy must proceed by command family with generated-artifact cutover and code-only rollback, incompatible with Click, DI containers, middleware frameworks, or stored-data changes.
